name: stateful-button
summary: Button whose label rolls and width springs through loading, success and error.
props: Controlled state. Omit it to let a Promise from onPress drive the button.
Resolve → success, reject → error, then back to idle (when state is not set).
Idle look; success and error tint it green / red.
ms the result shows before returning to idle (self-driving only).
Stretch to the parent's width (no width animation).
Blocks presses and dims the button.
Taps on press, success and error.
Style for the outer wrapper (margins, alignment).
behavior: Springs to 96% on press; at least 44pt tall to touch (hitSlop on the small size). Presses are ignored while loading and, when self-driving, until it returns to idle.
Label letters roll on the native driver; width, colour and the check / cross stroke spring or ease on the JS driver on separate views.
Labels crossfade instead of rolling and the width changes instantly.
Light tap on press, success / error notification on the result (expo-haptics; turn off with haptics={false}).
Button role with busy and disabled state; every new label (Saving…, Saved, Failed) is announced.
usage:
import { StatefulButton } from '@/components/ui/stateful-button';

<StatefulButton loadingText="Saving…" successText="Saved" onPress={() => save()}>
  Save changes
</StatefulButton>

<StatefulButton state={state} errorText="Retry">Upload</StatefulButton>
